Ravi S: Security plans to flip warm-pool egress to DENY in eu-west-1 at 21:00 UTC. This will block 0.0.0.0/0 unless we add exceptions. Expect new GPU node onboarding to fail if keystore/KMS access is blocked.

Ellen T: Can we add narrow privatelink exception for keystore and keep registry via NAT for now? Need least-priv carveouts.

Ravi S: Yes. Plan: privatelink for keystore (443, 9090 metrics), create temporary KMS alias that maps old -> new key and grant a 'warm-bootstrap' role kms:Decrypt for 48h. Terraform changes in infra/vpc branch.

Marco V: Cost note: NAT for registry ~ $420/mo for est 4TB; privatelink relay ~ $190/mo + ENI. Suggest hybrid for 72h rollout.

ops-bot: tf plan applied to staging; prod apply queued for 21:00 UTC.

Ravi S: Rollout steps: 1) apply privatelink SG carveout to warm subnets (canary subset) 2) create kms alias & policy for warm-bootstrap role 3) launch 3 canary nodes 4) monitor provisioning.fail_rate, bootstrap.kms_errors for 60m, rollback if >3% failures.

ops-bot: prod apply started 21:00:05 UTC (run id r-20260323-9).

Ellen T: Canary i-0f1a2b3c provisioned; node-init KMS decrypt OK, docker pulls OK. Provision ~78s (baseline 60s).

Marco V: Logged cost ticket infra-privatelink-costs. Keep flowlogs at 100% for warm subnets for 48h.

Ravi S: Leaving exception for 48h, then rotate alias and remove carveout if no regressions. Ping me on any InstanceProfile:AccessDenied or kms:Decrypt errors. Thanks everyone.
